speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing hand tremors and recent memory issues; when did these symptoms first start, and are they affecting your ability to perform daily tasks?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Have you noticed any changes in his handwriting, or does he experience stiffness or slowness in his movements?

REQUEST TEST: Full neurological exam, including assessment for rigidity, bradykinesia, and resting tremor.
